description: Finite-temperature two-phase equation of state (X branch + quintic Hermite join + plasma, smooth-maximum floors; docs/eos_finite_T.md), p0, T, mu, s on the (eps/eps_s, rho/rho_s) lattice. REDUCED TEST LATTICE for CI (step 0.2 in x, 0.08 in y).
index_order: p0, T, mu, s: C order, shape (nx, ny), element (ix, iy) at flat index ix*ny + iy (iy fastest); eps_min: shape (ny,) indexed by iy; all float64 little-endian, fields stored consecutively in the order of 'fields'
